documentCursorCompletionAgent.codeBlockR: The cursor is in a {language} code block. Complete only raw code inside the current block, preserve indentation using codeLinePrefix, add line breaks only when needed, use at most 160 characters, and do not add code fences or language markers.

documentCursorCompletionAgent.textBlockR: Complete only one phrase or sentence in the current text block, use at most 80 characters, do not add line breaks, and do not create headings, lists, or other blocks.
documentCursorCompletionAgent.inlineCode: The current text uses inline code. Output raw text only and do not add backticks.
documentCursorCompletionAgent.marksRule: The current text has these marks: {marks}. Output text only and do not repeat Markdown formatting markers.
documentCursorCompletionAgent.promptInst: Use the document-cursor-completion Skill to perform FIM completion in a rich-text document. Generate only the content that belongs at <CURSOR />.

documentCursorCompletionAgent.structureR: Do not repeat PREFIX or SUFFIX. Match the current Tiptap block type, ancestor structure, and marks.

onboarding.guideUseful3: Review the Room overview and next steps after a meaningful change.

onboarding.guideWorkflow2: Record important decisions and keep the current goal visible.
onboarding.guideWorkflow3: Ask the Agent to summarize evidence, compare options, or turn context into next actions.
onboarding.guideWorkflow4: Review generated suggestions and update the Room when the work changes.
